test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who was the India's flag bearer at the opening ceremony of Tokyo Olympics 2020 with Mary Kom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manpreet Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom__**, the 6-time world boxing champion, and **Manpreet Singh who is** the **Indian men's hockey team skipper** **will be India's flag-bearers at the opening ceremony of the Tokyo Olympics 2020.**
 
• Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom OLY is an **Indian amateur boxer, politician, and incumbent Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha**.
 
• Manpreet Singh Sandhu is an **Indian field hockey player and the captain of India's men's national field hockey team since May 2017**.
 
• The Olympic 2021 was held in Tokyo, Japan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Subedar Neeraj Chopra is an **Indian athlete who is the Olympic champion in **javelin throw******.****
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya **is an** Indian freestyle wrestler **who won a silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the 57 kg category.
 
• Dutee Chand is an **Indian sprinter and present national champion in the women's 100 metres event**.
